title: Nu Html Checker rejected ARIA on generic divs and surfaced avoidable HTML syntax/info messages
workflow: standalone HTML build -> standards conformance verification
symptom: Formal conformance returned 10 messages: 2 ARIA errors on generic divs, 7 trailing-slash informational findings on void elements, and 1 section-without-heading warning.
expected_behavior: The standalone delivery carrier should produce zero Nu Html Checker messages under the existing strict Artifact wrapper.
actual_behavior: Browser execution was functional, but standards validation exposed avoidable markup debt.
proposed_fix: Use explicit non-interactive group roles where labels are needed, remove XHTML-style slashes from HTML void elements, and use a generic notes container where no section heading is intended.
fix_attempt: Patched source index.html and rebuilt the standalone carrier.
verification: Repeat Artifact Nu Html Checker 26.9.7 returned PASS with messageCount=0 for the exact standalone carrier.
